##### Project general facts

Erin by Meraas is a premium residential development within the Central Park community at City Walk, combining contemporary architecture with natural elements and refined urban living. The building comprises a basement, ground floor, eleven residential floors, and a rooftop level, offering a selection of 1- to 4-bedroom apartments and spacious 5-bedroom penthouses. Thoughtfully designed interiors, smart home technologies, and floor-to-ceiling windows create bright and elegant living spaces with views of the lush park and Dubai skyline.

The development offers an extensive range of amenities designed to support a comfortable and balanced lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, gym, water play areas, sports courts, picnic pavilions, and barbecue areas. A spa with sauna, yoga and meditation zones, and dedicated conference rooms further enhance the community, providing spaces for wellness, recreation, relaxation, and social activities.

The residences combine refined interior design with modern functionality and smart home features. Natural materials and carefully considered details create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere, while floor-to-ceiling windows maximise natural light and views. The development offers a contemporary living environment where comfort, technology, and elegant design come together.

##### Location description and benefits

City Walk is a prestigious urban destination located in Al Wasl, in the heart of Dubai. Positioned at the junction of Al Wasl Road and Safa Road, the area offers excellent connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, and Jumeirah Beach Road. Its central location places residents within easy reach of many of the city’s key destinations.

Designed as a vibrant lifestyle district, City Walk combines contemporary residences with international retail, gourmet restaurants, luxury hotels, and a wide range of leisure and entertainment options. The neighbourhood is also home to Central Park, providing expansive green spaces, landscaped areas, outdoor fitness facilities, running tracks, and spaces for recreation and socialising.

City Walk offers a unique balance between dynamic urban living and a peaceful green environment. Residents benefit from convenient access to Dubai Mall and Downtown, Jumeirah Beach, healthcare facilities, and major entertainment venues, while attractions such as The Green Planet and Coca-Cola Arena add to the area’s vibrant lifestyle. This combination of connectivity, greenery, and premium amenities makes City Walk one of Dubai’s most distinctive residential destinations.
